archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) and ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk (Premium, authoritative, modern. NEVER use Inter/Roboto for headings)
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans (Sterile, clean tech body font perfect for data)
typography.rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Overlines MUST be uppercase + tiny + wide spacing. Line Height: Tight for headers, Loose for body. H1 ceiling is text-6xl.

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Tint neutral greys with cool blue. High contrast for readability. Minimum 4.5:1 ratio. No full-screen gradients.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky navs (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/70 border border-white/10). Flat solid backgrounds with 1px borders for dashboard widgets. Tracing beam for high-conversion pricing cards.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp minimal buttons. Never use generic styles. Hover explicitly defines text color.
components.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular styles for Dashboard. Shadcn UI.
components.forms: Shadcn Input, Select, Form. Never native.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts) with accessible palettes.

grids.marketing: The 'Tetris' Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, wide gaps).
grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps).

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use p-12 to p-24 for marketing sections. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-First. Left-align dense content. Optical alignment over mathematical alignment.
layouts.dashboard: Left-sidebar navigation, top-left focus for core progress metrics.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions for all hover states. Entrance stagger animations for lists. Use specific properties for transitions (NOT transition: all). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast calculator preferred. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations.

media.rules: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Max hero overlay opacity bg-black/50.

3d_libraries.recommendation: React Spring Parallax for '2.5D' storytelling on the marketing landing page (layering charts behind text). TS Particles for subtle floating network dots in the hero background.
3d_libraries.decision: Not strictly necessary for the core product, but good for marketing hero impact. Avoid Drei/R3F to keep the platform fast.

image_urls.description: Dark candlestick chart for the hero section.
Professional user studying stock market on a laptop.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Apply 'Cabinet Grotesk' font to headings. Do NOT use Inter for headings.
Implement Shadcn components heavily but strip the Vercel look.
Add layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and generous spacing (p-8 to p-12).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
Create a dark mode platform matching the Premium Finance vibe, with Slate/Navy bases and Emerald accents.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide React for crisp, professional iconography.
For the dashboard, use cardless or flat rectangular styles, no glassmorphism.
Include Free, Full Course, and Premium pricing tiers natively integrated with the design.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filter (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or equivalent js format
